title: [v0.92][planning] Establish the v0.92.1 corporate, C-SDLC v3, and distributed Runtime milestone
body:
Closes #146

## Summary

- establish the canonical planning-only v0.92.1 milestone package
- preserve 45 complete work-package specifications for corporate/IP transfer, C-SDLC v3, distributed Runtime qualification, and the standard closeout tail
- use the canonical nine-step closeout sequence: demo convergence, quality gate, docs alignment, internal review, external review, remediation and final preflight, next-milestone planning, next-milestone review, and release ceremony with lifecycle closeout
- make post-merge operator bootstrap responsible for creating WP-01; WP-01 then exclusively creates and validates the downstream live issue wave
- preserve the retired #149-#190 planning work in its source-anchored, explicitly non-authoritative archive without reopening or reusing those issues
- preserve all eleven mandatory C-SDLC v3 decisions and keep release ceremony as the terminal lifecycle boundary
